items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Danny Logan joined me in New York.

ctx.x: So, this grandmother used to switch me around in class cause I must have been a devil. Well, she had switched me maybe about twice. Taught me a lesson.
Well, how about Danny Logan. Danny Logan joined me in New York. He used to play with some of the big name bands there. Ray Hogan,
also, I think he was with Andy Kirk a year before he joined me. He was, they were both two fine trombone players.
